name: get_maplet
description: Fetch real map data around a coordinate and return a token-budgeted topological graph: named places joined by walkable edges with distances in metres and compass directions. Use this to answer 'what is near X' and 'how do I get from A to B'. Omissions are reported, so treat a missing feature as not-shown rather than absent.

radiusM.description: Radius in metres. Default 300. Larger costs more tokens.

layers.description: Semantic layers to include, e.g. ["road", "poi"]. Default all.

budget.description: Token budget for the response. Default 1024, hard cap 8192.

returnScr.description: Also return the wire SCR in a second content block. Keep it: it is the session state a later localize() call moves within, and the agent stores it in its own RAM rather than the chat context.

name: localize
description: Move within a map session you already hold. Pass the session SCR (from get_maplet with returnScr, or from the last localize) and your new position; the answer is only the delta: + places that entered view, - places that left it, ~ places that moved or updated. Store the updated SCR from the second content block and discard the old one.

scr.description: Session state: the SCR string from the previous get_maplet or localize.

layers.description: Semantic layers to include, e.g. ["road", "poi"]. Default all.

budget.description: Token budget for the re-fit view. Default 1024, hard cap 8192.

name: route
description: Feasibility between two coordinates: straight-line distance, the compass direction to head, and nothing that pretends to be turn-by-turn navigation. Turn-by-turn comes only from a routing engine the operator has verified; the default answer ends in "verify the approach on arrival", which is the honest limit of what it computes.

name: search_places
description: Find named places (cafes, stations, shops) near a coordinate. Cheaper than get_maplet when only names are needed.

query.description: Substring match on place name or type.

name: expand_feature
description: Fetch the exact geometry of features by id, as WKT. Use only when shape matters, such as checking whether a route clears a building.

scr.description: SCR document from a previous get_maplet.

name: get_terrain
description: Sample ground elevation around a coordinate, in metres. Returns the range plus high and low points, which is what an agent needs for grade reasoning.

name: get_weather
description: Current weather conditions and a short forecast at a coordinate. Use this before telling someone to walk, cycle, or drive, or to pick between an indoor and outdoor option. Reports what is actually falling (rain, snow, sleet) rather than only a temperature.

hours.description: Forecast horizon in hours. Default 12, max 48.

name: get_air
description: Air quality at a coordinate: European and US AQI bands, particulate load, and the forecast window. Use this before sending someone into prolonged outdoor exertion, or before recommending a walking route to a person with respiratory sensitivities.

hours.description: Forecast horizon in hours. Default 12, max 48.

name: get_daylight
description: Sun position, sunrise, sunset, and twilight state for a coordinate. Twilight is reported as day, civil, nautical, or night rather than a boolean, because "needs a torch" and "cannot see" are different states.

at.description: ISO 8601 instant. Defaults to now. Times are UTC.
